{"metadata":{"description":"Visual annotation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: select elements in local app previews and send structured UI feedback to your agent.","id":"gh:1378325942","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-annotate","slug":"alaliqing/dsh-annotate","topics":["deepseek-harness","developer-tools","dsh-plugin","ui-annotation","visual-feedback"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Visual annotation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: select elements in local app previews and send struct"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ured UI feedback to your agent."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-annotate"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** · 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Point at the UI. Give your coding agent the exact context.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"`dsh-annotate` adds a visual review panel to DeepSeek Harness Desktop and its web client.
Open a loc"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"al app, click the elements you want changed, leave notes, and send the
whole review to your conversa"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"tion as structured text."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Give a coding agent this prompt:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The commands below install `0.1.15` and can also upgrade an existing install."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Desktop (macOS)"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Open Desktop once to initialize its profile. It can stay open during installation.
Use its bundled C"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"LI; with the app installed in `/Applications`:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Adjust the app path if needed. After the current task finishes, **fully quit and
reopen Desktop**, t"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"hen click **Annotate** or press `⌘/Ctrl⇧B`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Web"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"With the web CLI, Node.js 20+ and pnpm available, run:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Replace `web` with your profile name if needed. After the current task finishes,
restart that profil"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"e and refresh the browser, then open **Annotate**."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"If installation fails, the panel is missing after restart, or you are upgrading
`0.1.2` or earlier, "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"see installation troubleshooting.
See compatibility for tested versions."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## What it gives you"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Zero-config discovery** of running loopback development servers, including
IPv4 and IPv6, with t"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"he services that belong to the current workspace first.
- **Static pages need no server:** an `index"},{"id":"p21s3","text":".html` — or a built page under
`dist/`, `build/`, `out/` or `public/` — is offered straight from the"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"
workspace and previewed from its own directory.
- **Focused feedback:** your full note and an eleme"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"nt locator, with extra
verification context only when the selector is ambiguous or unverified.
- **M"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"arkers that stay attached** through window or nested scrolling, resizing,
and layout shifts.
- **Two"},{"id":"p21s7","text":" explicit send paths:** send the review by itself, or add it to the
current draft. Failed sends keep"},{"id":"p21s8","text":" every annotation.
- **Isolated previews** that preserve app routes, assets, fetches, and WebSocket
"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"upgrades without sharing the Harness origin.
- **English and Chinese UI**, switchable from the toolb"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"aring the Harness origin.
- **English and Chinese UI**, switchable from the toolbar’s **More** menu."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"No screenshot is captured. Mark mode adds a temporary crosshair and overlay,
while page and containe"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"r scrolling stays native. By default, the plugin
only discovers servers you already run; process con"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"trol requires an explicitly
configured command."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Use"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. Start your app's development server.
2. Open a Harness conversation, then press `⌘/Ctrl⇧B` or cho"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ose **Annotations** from the right sidebar.
3. Choose a detected service or one of the workspace's s"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"tatic pages, or enter a
port or loopback URL.
4. Click **Mark**, select an element, and write a note"},{"id":"p24s4","text":".
5. Press **Enter** or click **Save**, then select the next element to keep
annotating. Press **Esc"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"** or **Mark** again to exit. Click a numbered marker
to view its note; click inside its text to edi"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"t. Unchanged notes never become drafts. Esc or an outside click keeps actual changes as a resumable "},{"id":"p24s7","text":"draft; **Cancel** discards them.
6. Use the floating bottom bar to send the batch. Click its count t"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"o view notes; its **More** menu offers **Add to composer**."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Key | Action |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| `Enter` | Save and continue marking |
| `Shift+Enter` | Insert a newline |
| `Esc` | Close the car"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"d and leave marking mode; keep actual changes |
| `⌘/Ctrl` + click | Save and send the batch |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Annotations and drafts are stored by Harness conversation and full app URL, so
routes restore indepe"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ndently and conversations never share notes."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Rows are ordered by how likely they are to be yours: a service whose process was
started inside the "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"conversation's workspace is tagged **This project**, a port
the workspace names in `package.json` or"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" a Vite config is tagged **Configured
port**, then the common-port order follows. Static pages are l"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"isted under their
own heading, and when exactly one candidate exists it opens on its own — a
static "},{"id":"p28s5","text":"page only when no server is running at all."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## What gets sent"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Each batch includes the full app URL once. Notes are never truncated; target
labels are capped at 64"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" characters. Computed styles and component chains stay
out of the message. If the selector has zero/"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"multiple matches, is invalid or
has no recorded match count, the message explicitly asks for verific"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"ation and
adds available semantic, component and geometry hints. No selector is treated
as uniquely "},{"id":"p31s5","text":"matched without a captured count of one."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## How the preview stays isolated"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"A normal cross-origin iframe does not expose its DOM. Instead of moving the app
onto the Harness ori"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"gin, `dsh-annotate` gives each conversation/app pair an
ephemeral loopback origin and injects a smal"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"l shim and picking overlay."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- Panel and overlay validate both message source and origin.
- Targets are restricted to `localhost`"},{"id":"p34s2","text":", `127.0.0.1`, and `[::1]`.
- A static page is served by the plugin itself, read-only, from its own
"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"directory on a loopback origin: `GET`/`HEAD` only, nothing outside the
workspace, no dotfiles, and a"},{"id":"p34s4","text":" 64 MiB ceiling per file.
- App cookies are namespaced; unprefixed cookies are stripped both ways.
-"},{"id":"p34s5","text":" Closing a panel, returning to the service list, or switching apps releases its
preview. Other windo"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"ws using the same preview keep it alive. Abandoned previews
expire after five minutes without activi"},{"id":"p34s7","text":"ty or a renewed lease; plugin disposal
closes all remaining servers and sockets."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"This is a local development tool, not a browser sandbox. OAuth flows, strict
origin allowlists, serv"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"ice workers, restrictive CSP, Shadow DOM internals,
cross-origin child frames, and individual canvas"},{"id":"p35s3","text":" objects may need a normal
browser or app-specific setup. The full cookie model has only been valida"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"d a normal
browser or app-specific setup. The full cookie model has only been validated in
Chromium."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Optional configuration"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"For `0.1.3` and later, put this override in your active profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` (`$DSH_HOME/pro"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"files/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`, with
`DSH_HOME` defaulting to `~/.dsh`); the bundle supplies the "},{"id":"p38s3","text":"plugin row.
[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
